commit_message:
Relocate pre-coder snapshots outside coder write grant

Move pre-coder-head, tracked-paths, and path-diff snapshots to
.pre-coder-snapshots under IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR so Codex cannot tamper
with #3272 carryover classification. MAV retains head-only behavior.
